title: New Website Launch!
bodyHtml:
Bigger, Bolder and Built for You

We’re excited to announce the launch of our new website—designed to inspire, inform, and make locating the right products for your bathroom project easier than ever.

With a bold new visual identity and a cleaner navigation, the new site is a more intuitive and immersive way to explore the full Studio Bagno collection.


Slim in Brass - PVD on Stainless Steel

Introducing 16 New Product Lines

2025 marks our most ambitious product release to date. From sculptural centrepieces and Vortex flush innovation to compact solutions and refined updates to Studio Bagno classics, you can now explore all new arrivals online.


Happy Hour - Part of our New Arrivals

Smarter Navigation, Streamlined Search + Filtering

Finding the right products for your project needs has never been simpler. Discover our complete offering via enhanced navigation and faster filtering, tailored to the way you work.

Easily filter by dimensions, price, and shape, and explore our range with a smarter navigation system that makes the collection more accessible and tailored to your project needs—including newly introduced overflow-specific categories for basins and baths.


Smart Filtering Streamlines your selection process

Quick View, Smarter Browsing

Our new Quick View functionality allows you to preview key product details—such as available colour options, technical data, and dimensions—without leaving the product list page.

This streamlined experience helps you evaluate options faster and with greater clarity, ensuring a more efficient workflow when specifying for your next project.


Quick View lets you see an overview of our products, without leaving the listing page

Explore our new Website

With an expanded collection, improved navigation, and an enriched library of tools and insights, our new website is designed to support your specification journey at every step.

Explore the latest product releases, uncover design inspiration, and find the perfect solution—faster, and more intuitively than ever before.

Explore the New Website
